$comment: Allowlist for check_fact_category_pinning.py (brief §5 C.7, SUDDHA-VACA Phase C lane:ci-lint). Every entry requires: file (repo-relative POSIX path, must match a Violation.file exactly), EITHER line (int, matched exactly against the violation's line number) OR pattern (a string matched as a regex, falling back to a plain substring match, against the violation's snippet text) — line is preferred when known since it is unambiguous; pattern is for cases where line drift is expected, and justification (a non-empty, specific, human-readable reason — 'pre-existing' alone is not sufficient, say WHY it's safe or why it's out of scope). An entry with neither line nor pattern never matches anything (fails closed, not open). Populated 2026-07-28 during the initial rollout scan against the live repo tree (this worktree, base main, before this wave's other lanes landed) — see the ci-lint lane's session report for the full disposition rationale of every entry. A matching entry covers one finding by default. max_occurrences freezes the observed count when several intentionally share a pattern.
